title: Kyogre and Spirit
spec: 2 airframes · 120 in span · S1223 wing · NACA 0012 tail · balsa, ply and carbon fibre
summary: Two seasons as mechanical lead for lifting surfaces and aerodynamics on UBC AeroDesign's Advanced Class team: Kyogre in 2021–22, then Spirit, a blended wing body built twice in 2022–23. Sketches, XFLR5, CAD, the build, and how it ended: a crash, one flight and two shipments lost by UPS.
